chunks.text: Hello! I am your American Family Digital Coverage Advisor. I can help you understand your auto and home coverages, deductibles, limits, and bundling discounts. How can I assist you today?

userInput.text: What is water backup and service line coverage?

chunks.text: Water Backup covers damage caused by water or sewage backing up through drains, sewers, or sump pump overflow, which standard homeowners policies exclude (available limits: $5,000 to $25,000). Service Line coverage pays to repair or replace damaged underground utility lines (water, sewer, electrical, gas, internet) running from the street to your home.
